newsitem.title: UK: UK's Glasgow Rangers to sell stake to outsider - FT.
newsitem.headline: UK's Glasgow Rangers to sell stake to outsider - FT.

text.p: Scottish soccer club Glasgow Rangers will sell an estimated 30 million pound ($49.82 million) stake to an outside investor, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.

Owner David Murray, whose controlling stake in the club would be cut to 82 percent, was quoted as saying he had not been tempted to float Rangers on the stock market despite strong investor demand for soccer shares.
"We wanted to do a private placing because we wish to put off going public until we know where digital television and European football competition are going," Murray said.
The Financial Times said an unnamed British billionaire was expected to buy the stake, with money from the sale earmarked for buying players and for building projects.
The report followed news on Tuesday that English soccer club Millwall Holdings Plc had called in administrators to help weather a financial crisis.
